configuration.authorization: User requested continuing the ladder climb after the verified v6 official result.
configuration.prior_evidence: Saved v6 complete diagnostics show missing clocks account for 49.6069% seasonal and 21.8776% forward SSE. V6 global CatBoost uses nearly its 6000-tree cap. A previous ground-only missing-NM LightGBM expert failed promotion; this batch separately tests CatBoost, the core/ground weather feature ablation, and a more regularized LightGBM expert. No new component score was inspected before declaration.
configuration.refit_iterations: Each active new component uses the ties-to-even rounded median of its two October-selected tree counts. Parent v6 native components retain their original frozen refit counts.
configuration.routing: Clock availability is a supplied covariate. Present and missing routes partition every row; weights are common across all airports and both folds. Negative and extreme labels remain included. Missing experts retain the unchanged Phase-4 conditional LIRF schedule offset.
configuration.selection: Finish all eight new native fits and all 36 declared complete candidate comparisons before selection. Require at least 0.5% lower RMSE than v6 on EACH original fold; select the eligible candidate with the lowest equally weighted mean RMSE ratio. No airport-specific weights or rules based on scoring IDs. Otherwise retain v6.
